title: Count Strictly Increasing Subarrays
summary: Given an array of positive integers, count the number of contiguous subarrays that are strictly increasing.
statement: Given an array of positive integers, count the number of contiguous subarrays that are strictly increasing.
constraints: Count nonempty contiguous subarrays whose adjacent values are strictly increasing.
Equal adjacent values break an increasing run.
Return the total across all endpoints.
hints: Track the length of the strictly increasing run ending at each element.
Extend the run only when previous < current; otherwise reset it to one.
Add the current run length to the answer.
Exactly one increasing subarray ends at the current position for every possible start within its maximal increasing suffix.
editorial: Exactly one increasing subarray ends at the current position for every possible start within its maximal increasing suffix.

tests.explanation: The increasing run lengths ending at each position are one, two, three, one, one, and two, totaling ten.
All ten nonempty subarrays are strictly increasing.
